title: Missy Bachelorette N Bachelor Party Boat
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
We offer unforgettable private boat tours and party cruises on the beautiful waterways of Charleston. Perfect for celebrations like bachelorette parties, birthdays, or simply enjoying a cruise, these charters promise a fun and relaxing experience. Each tour includes a captain, a state-of-the-art sound system, coolers with ice for your beverages, and comfortable seating. Whether you opt for a 2-hour trip or a longer gathering with friends, prepare to make lasting memories on the water.

- Choose from 2, 3, or 4-hour private charters, ideal for any occasion
- All boats come equipped with a sound system, seating, coolers, and ice
- Perfect for bachelorette parties, birthdays, and relaxing cruises
